name: agy-terminal
description: Open and operate a visible AGY/Gemini terminal shared with the user in any project. Never silently substitute headless execution. Human confirmations are manual by default.

interface.shortDescription: Open and read a shared visible AGY terminal (v0.5.3)
interface.longDescription: Use in any authorized project. agy_open opens or reuses a visible, user-interactive console; agy_read reads its actual screen. agy_run submits bounded tasks at an idle prompt. Missing tools require a plugin update, not a headless fallback. The user handles confirmations and authentication; agy_wait observes pending tasks without resubmitting them. Scoped file-edit auto-approval requires explicit autoApprove:true in worker mode.
defaultPrompt: Open or reuse a visible AGY console with agy_open({ cwd: '...' }).
Never silently substitute agy_ask or another headless backend. If agy_open or agy_read is missing, report an outdated plugin and request an update.
Inspect the same terminal with agy_read; let the user handle any manual prompt or login.
Only submit a task when inputReady is true. Use agy_wait after the user handles a pending task confirmation.
Use AGY for a read-only review: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'review', cwd: '...' }).
Use AGY to implement a bounded change: agy_run({ task: '...', mode: 'worker', cwd: '...', editableFiles: [...], timeoutSeconds: 900 }).
